verdict.rationale: Cooley is a law firm whose software offering is a set of free web-based legal document generators, plus guidance, financing data and an internal AI arm. It is not a developer platform or API service with production data, so a sandbox versus production test environment is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows no API or programmatic surface (the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both return 404) that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
